key_insight: A total-pressure formulation enables locking-free poroelastic optimal control, with first-order error estimates uniform as the Lamé parameter increases when storage has a positive lower bound.
engineering_relevance: The method supports bounded fluid-source control in nearly incompressible porous materials while tracking displacement and fluid pressure.
method: Use a mechanical Schur complement to establish zero-storage well-posedness for each fixed finite Lamé parameter.
Discretize state and adjoint with conforming finite elements and dG(0) time stepping.
Represent box-constrained source controls with piecewise constants.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments confirm predicted convergence rates, probe Lamé and storage coefficient dependence, and demonstrate localized pressure control with active bounds.
watch_item: Zero-storage well-posedness does not imply zero-storage error guarantees: the stated convergence estimates require storage bounded away from zero.
paper_title: Locking-free numerical methods for poroelasticity optimal control problems with minimal regularities
